note: Visual + voice consistency lock for every render. Use the SAME appearance descriptor + color + voice every time a member appears, so the cast is identical across episodes (the #1 quality tell). House style: cinematic, void-navy backdrop, neon-wireframe humanoid (the look from the Prometheus character art), Fraunces/Sora type. Voices cross-ref config/voice-map.json. Image style suffix for all: 'cinematic, high-contrast, dark background, glowing neon wireframe figure, volumetric light, 8k, no text artifacts, clean hands'.
negative_prompts: blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, low contrast, cluttered background, unreadable text, watermark, logo errors
